sourceRecords.note: Legal/commercial (Latin mora, 'delay'); 'interessi di mora', 'messa in mora' (formal notice of default). Homonym: mora = blackberry.

sourceRecords.en: default (delay in payment); late-payment interest period
sourceRecords.it: Sul debito maturano gli interessi di mora dal giorno della scadenza.
sourceRecords.exEn: Default interest accrues on the debt from the due date.
sourceRecords.note: Fixed phrases 'interessi di mora', 'in mora', 'messa in mora'. Homonym: 'mora' = blackberry.

rows.reason: Guarantee on a bill of exchange versus institutional backing.
rows.reviewScope: All source English glosses and Italian examples contrasted manually; source translations/notes retained as evidence, not globally approved.

sourceRecords.en: guarantee (on a bill of exchange); backing; endorsement
sourceRecords.it: Senza l'avallo di un garante, nessuna banca gli avrebbe scontato la cambiale.
sourceRecords.exEn: Without a guarantor's backing, no bank would have discounted the bill of exchange.
sourceRecords.note: Technical (from French aval); figurative and more common: 'dare il proprio avallo' = to approve, to back. Verb: avallare.

sourceRecords.en: aval; guarantee on a bill of exchange; (fig.) backing, endorsement
sourceRecords.it: La proposta è passata con l'avallo del ministero dell'Economia.
sourceRecords.exEn: The proposal went through with the backing of the Ministry of the Economy.
sourceRecords.note: Financial term now common figuratively; verb 'avallare' (to endorse, vouch for).
